niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency or platform, as the right choice depends on your budget, whether you need managed service or self-serve software, and your specific campaign goals.
Top-rated CTV agencies and programmatic platforms are categorized below by their primary strengths:
Strategus: Known as a dedicated CTV/OTT programmatic specialist providing end-to-end campaign management, pre-launch blueprinting, and 24/7 outcome-driven reporting across premium inventory like Netflix and Hulu.
Chamber Media: Specializes in performance-driven creative strategy and media buying across major CTV environments, including Amazon DSP, Hulu, and Peacock, tailored to scaling direct-to-consumer brands.
Socium Media: Provides full-funnel CTV prospecting and remarketing strategies, though it typically requires a minimum monthly ad spend around $50,000 for structured 3-month testing phases. www.strategus.com +2
StackAdapt: Frequently ranked #1 for ease of use and customer support among self-serve demand-side platforms (DSPs), featuring premium CTV inventory, pod bidding to prevent ad repetition, and creative studio services.
The Trade Desk: A powerhouse programmatic platform offering massive global publisher access, advanced Koa AI optimization, and cross-device attribution suited for enterprise-level omnichannel campaigns.
Tatari: A specialized convergent TV platform that allows brands and agencies to plan, buy, optimize, and measure linear TV and streaming CTV campaigns inside a single interface with transparent attribution tools.
Vibe: Highly rated by marketers for SMB and mid-market growth, featuring granular audience targeting, easy Shopify/Klaviyo integrations, and Vibe Studio for quick, TV-ready creative solutions. Business of Apps +3
For Self-Serve Campaigns: Choose StackAdapt or The Trade Desk if you have an in-house media buying team and want direct control over targeting and optimization.
For Cross-Platform / Linear + Streaming: Choose Tatari if you need to unify traditional TV ads with modern streaming video budgets.
For Done-For-You Strategy & Creative: Choose a dedicated agency like Strategus if you prefer external experts to handle setup, creative adaptation, and live optimization. The Trade Desk +3
